PostToolUse.description: Auto-format Python files with black + isort after write/edit
Detect print() statements left in production app code

hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
path = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if path and path.endswith('.py') and '/app/' in path and '/tests/' not in path:
    r = subprocess.run(['grep', '-n', r'\bprint(', path], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.stdout.strip():
        print(f'[hook] print() found in {path} — consider using the logger instead:', file=sys.stderr)
        print(r.stdout.strip(), file=sys.stderr)
"

Stop.description: Flake8 lint on modified Python files after Claude finishes

hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
py_files = [f for f in result.stdout.splitlines() if f.endswith('.py') and 'migrations' not in f]
if py_files:
    r = subprocess.run(['poetry', 'run', 'flake8', '--max-line-length=100'] + py_files, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.stdout.strip():
        print('[hook] flake8 issues on modified files:', file=sys.stderr)
        print(r.stdout.strip(), file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(f'[hook] flake8 clean on {len(py_files)} modified file(s)', file=sys.stderr)
"
